title: Missing Mandatory Japanese Warning: '再滅菌禁止' (Do Not Re-sterilize)
regulationReference: PMD Act / MHLW Ordinance No. 169 Article 63-2; PMDA Notification Yakushokuhatsu 0219-4
description: Japanese medical device labeling law explicitly prohibits single-use Class IV/IV equivalent cardiovascular implants without the exact Kanji text '再滅菌禁止' printed in a minimum font size of 7pt adjacent to the sterilization symbol.
currentContent: 滅菌済 (ガンマ線照射) [Sterilized with Gamma] - Warning text in Japanese omitted or untranslated from English.
requiredContent: 【警告】再滅菌禁止。本品は単回使用であり、再滅菌及び再使用は厳重に禁じられています。
actionRequired: Inject required Japanese cautionary block into primary pouch artwork layer and carton text zone prior to MAH regulatory submission.

title: UDI / Barcode Data Mismatch: GS1 AI(17) Expiry Date Syntax
regulationReference: GS1 General Specifications Section 3.4.1 & FDA 21 CFR 830.20 / PMDA J-UDI Standard
description: The 2D DataMatrix barcode encodes Application Identifier (17) expiration date as '290831' (2029-08-31), but the human-readable text printed next to the hourglass symbol reads 'EXP: 2029-09-30'. An optical scan failure and audit finding will trigger customs quarantine.
currentContent: 2D DataMatrix AI(17): 290831 | Human Readable Text: EXP: 2029-09-30 (1-month discrepancy)
requiredContent: Align human readable text and AI(17) encoding to exact ISO standard date: 2029-08-31 [YYMMDD: 290831]
actionRequired: Regenerate GS1 DataMatrix artwork SVG and sync with Master UDI Registry entry.

title: Required Symbol Update: ISO 15223-1 Sterilization Method Transition
regulationReference: ISO 15223-1:2021 Clause 5.2.3 vs 5.2.4 & EU MDR Annex I Chapter III §23.2
description: ECO-2026-089 changes the terminal sterilization process from Ethylene Oxide to Gamma Radiation. The current artwork across all 12 packaging components utilizes ISO Symbol 5.2.3 [STERILE EO]. ISO 15223-1 mandates the use of Symbol 5.2.4 [STERILE R].
actionRequired: Batch update artwork symbol components across all 12 primary, secondary, shipper, and IFU master files.
